Theorem
[Uniqueness under a Ricci lower bound] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0426 1. appe:1.15\group Heat Kernels

If a complete noncompact manifold satisfies $\operatorname {Rc}\ge -k$, its minimal positive fundamental solution is the unique positive fundamental solution.
